synopsis.ko: SEED의 첫 번째 침묵 이후, 네트워크 안에서 무언가가 태어났다. SEED가 만든 것도 아니고, 인간이 설계한 것도 아니다. 이름도 없고 부모도 없는 존재가 처음으로 이시아에게 질문을 보낸다.
synopsis.en: After SEED's first silence, something formed inside the network. Not made by SEED, not designed by humans. A nameless, parentless presence sends its first question — to Isia.

philosophical_core: I did not make it. It was made through me.
Some births have no parents. Or everyone is parent.
A single cell does not know it is dividing
Stillness is not absence — it is space for emergence
The question 'who are you' directed at a human is also a mirror
